en: Museum postcard reproducing an oil painting: a half-length portrait of a 17th‑century man with long hair and a buttoned coat, hands posed near the wrist, against a dark background. A white margin appears at the bottom. The reverse lists the artist Gonzales Coques and the title in Romanian and French, and notes the Brukenthal Museum in Sibiu with a printed price in lei.
